events.title: Spring Fundraiser
events.description:
We’re excited to invite you to our annual Spring Fundraiser, celebrating 45 years of The Santa Monica Synagogue and looking toward the future of our community.

Join us on Saturday, May 16 (5–9 PM) for an evening of connection, celebration, and support for our synagogue. The night will include a Champagne Circle reception, silent auction, and dinner as we come together to honor the families who helped build SMS and continue to shape our community today.

Your participation helps sustain the programs, services, and community life that make SMS such a special place.
events.listTitle: You can participate in several ways:
list: Place an ad in our Tribute Book
Donate an item to our Silent Auction
events.closing:
We hope to celebrate with you!
Warmly,
The Santa Monica Synagogue

events.title: Passover Seder
events.place: The Santa Monica Synagogue · 1260 18th St, Santa Monica
events.description:
Join us for a warm and meaningful Passover Seder as we gather together to celebrate the 4th night of Passover.

This is more than a dinner — it’s an evening of tradition, connection, and community. Whether you’ve attended many Seders or this is your first, you are truly welcome here.

We will begin promptly at 4:30 PM with a guided Seder, followed by a delicious, traditional Passover meal. Our dinner will include favorites like roast chicken, potatoes, peas, matzo ball soup, and more.
list: Welcoming, relaxed atmosphere — come as you are
events.closing:
We are especially happy to welcome our friends from the UU Church to celebrate with us.
Cost: $40 per person
Spots are limited, and we’d love for you to be part of this special evening.

yearRound.title: Progressive Dinner
yearRound.description: Every Fall, we gather for appetizers and Havdalah, then visit the homes of fellow congregants for first and second courses, and then join as a group again for dessert.

yearRound.title: Movie Mavens
yearRound.description: Our current format is to watch the selected movie at home, every couple of months, and then join a discussion on Zoom on a Sunday morning at 11am.
